codeReview.summary: The implementation correctly copies all design tokens (including oklch colors, spacing, radius, shadows, dark mode overrides, calendar, and event tokens) from the web globals.css to the mobile global.css. The @custom-variant dark directive is correctly added to support dark mode. Additionally, all hardcoded hex and rgb literals were removed from .native.tsx files, achieving feature requirements.
